samples.question: The picture shows white paper with several closed black fences painted on it; fences may cross one another. A room is a piece of white paper you can walk over without ever crossing a painted black fence line; the coloured dots are painted flat on the paper and never block the way, and you may not leave the paper. Every one of the three dots - red, green and blue - lies inside the same number of fences as the other two, and exactly two of them are in one and the same room. Which two dots are in the same room: red and green, red and blue, or green and blue?
